opus.problem: A talking donkey on the road gives the word away by itself. Almost any baker will know Balaam from this one clue, so it is not medium hard. Make it harder, for example by leaning on Balaam striking the donkey three times rather than the donkey speaking.

Two details are not in the cited verse Numbers 24:17. 'Looking over Israel's camp' comes from Numbers 24:2, and 'diviner' comes from Joshua 13:22. Either drop them or change the reference so every detail in the clue is backed by its verse.
